scope: D2.S2 source-owned imports design only; code and UAC review pending exact candidate
nonfinding_review_conditions: Policy must precede implementation, and any surface-rules schema constraints must be updated consistently.
A source canonical import runtime is a new explicit boundary, not an existing API at the dependency HEAD. Detached snapshots remain standalone; no ambient owner hydration.
Initial schema has no $ref. Any unsupported future JSON Schema relative refs must fail closed or be subject to an explicit closure rule, never silently accepted as portable.
Standalone receipt verifies self-consistency, never authenticity or approval.
No-import identity comparison must use actual pre-change code/snapshots, not expected values generated by the changed implementation.
Owner bytes and exactly seven D2.S1 owned resources must remain unchanged; architecture is the only existing SSOT behavior change.
UAC requirement review will be authored only after exact original/candidate/effective resources are available, without fabricated behavioral promotion.
positive_assessments: Explicit sole owner, pinned bytes and consumer allowlist
Full graph validation before build writes
No reexport ownership, collisions or implicit dependency imports
Detached generated receipt and retained declaration fail closed
No-import hash compatibility and finite closure
Additive optional architecture input and bounded rollback
evidence_limit: Read-only source/design inspection. No implementation or behavior success is claimed.

closed_findings.problem: The design binds import identity but omits updates to three source-location emitters, which currently attribute each resource to the consumer canonical directory. Imported schema bytes have no authored file at that path, so metadata would retain false original-source provenance.
closed_findings.required_repair: Specify and implement a canonical source-location accessor for imported resources using the actual owner/source path. Apply it consistently to skill_jobs, uac_modes, and topology; keep consumer-local destination distinct. Verify original owner-file line/hash references and unchanged local-resource source references.
closed_findings.verification: Regression checks should assert imported source metadata points to an existing owner-authored file with matching bytes, and no nonexistent consumer-authored path is emitted.
closed_findings.resolution: Revised design explicitly requires actual owner canonical path, portable destination separation, original lines and regressions in all three emitters; current implementation adds source_path and the three consumers use it.

editorial_note: Design text names src/intent_pipeline/topology.py once; actual file is src/core_prompts_eval/topology.py. Correct this reference at the next writer revision.
